grill-me.description: Relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design before implementation.
grill-me.template: Run the `grilling` skill. If the user passed context or an issue reference as $ARGUMENTS, use it as the seed for the interview. Otherwise ask the user what they want to build. Explore the codebase first if needed.

to-prd.description: Turn the current conversation into a PRD written to ./issues/.
to-prd.template: Load the `to-prd` skill and follow it. Save the PRD as a markdown file in ./issues/ with a slug filename (e.g. `PRD-<slug>.md`). Do NOT interview the user - synthesize from what has already been discussed. Extra context from user: $ARGUMENTS

to-issues.description: Break a PRD/plan into vertical-slice issues in ./issues/.
to-issues.template: Load the `to-issues` skill and follow it. Read the PRD from ./issues/ (path may be given as $ARGUMENTS). Write each issue as a separate markdown file to ./issues/ named `NN-<slug>.md` with NN being a zero-padded incrementing number. Include YAML frontmatter with `title`, `status: ready-for-agent`, `blocked_by: []`, and `type: afk` or `type: human-in-the-loop`.

improve-arch.description: Scan the codebase for module-deepening opportunities and produce an HTML report.
improve-arch.template: Run the `improve-codebase-architecture` skill. If $ARGUMENTS specifies a scope, focus on that area.

diagnose.description: Structured diagnosis loop for hard bugs.
diagnose.template: Run the `diagnosing-bugs` skill. The bug description is: $ARGUMENTS

prototype.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question.
prototype.template: Run the `prototype` skill. The design question is: $ARGUMENTS

handoff.description: Compact the current session into a handoff document for another agent.
handoff.template: Run the `handoff` skill. Focus for next session: $ARGUMENTS
